reviews.text:
I recently underwent hernia surgery at Renuka Hospital, and my experience was exceptional from start to finish. Dr. Naveen, who performed the surgery, was highly skilled and made me feel confident and at ease throughout the process. The procedure went smoothly, and I felt well-informed and cared for at every step.

Post-operation care was handled by Dr. Chiranjeevi and Dr. Pavan, who were both incredibly attentive and supportive. They ensured my recovery was on track, addressing all my concerns with patience and professionalism. The entire medical team was compassionate, and the hospital staff was courteous, making my stay as comfortable as possible.

I am extremely grateful to Dr. Naveen, Dr. Chiranjeevi, and Dr. Pavan for their outstanding care. I would highly recommend Renuka Hospital for anyone in need of hernia surgery or any other medical care.
